## Research and release checks

- [ ] Code and input rejection paths reviewed; appropriate tests and CI pass.
- [ ] Experimental design predates outputs; frozen inputs and failed attempts retained.
- [ ] Human annotation review is recorded and hash-bound before the new frontend.
- [ ] All planned cells and controls are accounted for; metrics can be recomputed.
- [ ] Conclusions distinguish evidence, inference, open questions and H1's candidate status.
- [ ] English and Chinese agree on numbers, limitations and experiment status.
- [ ] Media has source hashes, truthful captions and full local recordings; PDF pages checked.
- [ ] Another window's files, environments and jobs were left untouched.
- [ ] The owner explicitly approved merging this reviewed revision.

Keep incomplete research PRs as drafts. Do not enable auto-merge or push directly to main.
